cards.phonetic: yo trah-BAH-hoh en lah see-oo-DAHD ee BEE-boh en el KAHM-poh

cards.front: Mi madre cocina y mi padre limpia.
cards.back: My mother cooks and my father cleans.
cards.phonetic: mee MAH-dreh koh-SEE-nah ee mee PAH-dreh LEEM-pyah

cards.front: Nosotros leemos el periódico cada mañana.
cards.back: We read the newspaper every morning.
cards.phonetic: noh-SOH-trohs leh-EH-mohs el peh-RYOH-dee-koh KAH-dah mah-NYAH-nah

cards.front: Ellos escriben cartas a sus amigos.
cards.back: They write letters to their friends.
cards.phonetic: EH-yohs es-KREE-behn KAR-tahs ah soos ah-MEE-gohs

cards.back: I live near downtown.

cards.front: Me encantó la película de anoche.
cards.back: I loved the movie last night.
cards.phonetic: meh ehn-kahn-TOH lah peh-LEE-koo-lah deh ah-NOH-cheh

cards.front: A mi hermana le gusta cocinar.
cards.back: My sister likes to cook.
cards.phonetic: ah mee ehr-MAH-nah leh GOOS-tah koh-see-NAR

cards.back: Noise bothers me.
The class bores us.

cards.front: A mis hijos les gustan los deportes.
cards.back: My kids like sports.
cards.phonetic: ah mees EE-hohs lehs GOOS-tahn lohs deh-POR-tehs

cards.back: Could you open the window, please?
cards.phonetic: poh-DREE-ahs ah-BREER lah behn-TAH-nah por fah-VOR

cards.back: I'd like to reserve a table.
Would it be possible to change the appointment?
I would like a glass of water.
Would you mind helping me?
It was a beautiful wedding.
Everyone was dancing all night.

cards.front: Había mucha gente en la fiesta.
cards.back: There were a lot of people at the party.
cards.phonetic: ah-BEE-ah MOO-chah HEHN-teh en lah FYEHS-tah

cards.back: The music was excellent.
We had a lot of fun.
